blocks.content:
Local Self Government refers to the system under which local people manage their own affairs through elected bodies.

Objectives:
• Promote democratic participation at the grassroots level
• Ensure efficient local administration
• Reduce burden on central and state governments
• Encourage rural and urban development
Local Self Government refers to the system under which local people manage their own affairs through elected bodies.

items: Core Objective: Remember that promoting democratic participation at the 'grassroots level' is the fundamental goal.
Administrative Role: Frequently tested on how local bodies alleviate the administrative pressure on Central and State governments.
Definition Basis: Questions often test the concept of local people managing affairs through 'elected bodies'.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Local Self Government allows local citizens to manage their own affairs directly through elected bodies.
It aims to strengthen democracy by driving participation at the grassroots level.
It improves administrative efficiency and relieves the workload of central and state governments.
It fosters balanced growth and progress across both rural and urban areas.
